color-fg.$description: Default text color on light backgrounds.

color-bg-subtle.$description: Secondary surface background, used behind cards and panels.

color-primary.$description: Primary brand/action color for booking and other key actions.

color-primary-hover.$description: Hover/active state of the primary action color.

color-on-primary.$description: Text/icon color on top of the primary color.

color-border.$description: Default border color for cards, inputs, and dividers.

color-danger.$description: Destructive actions and error states, e.g. cancel booking.

color-success.$description: Confirmation states, e.g. a booking or payment succeeded.

color-muted.$description: Secondary/helper text, e.g. form hints and timestamps.

space-1.$description: Smallest spacing unit, e.g. gap between an icon and a label.

space-2.$description: Default spacing between related inline elements.

space-3.$description: Default spacing between stacked elements, e.g. form fields.

space-4.$description: Spacing between distinct sections of a page.

radius-sm.$description: Corner radius for chips and small controls.

radius-md.$description: Corner radius for buttons and form inputs.

radius-lg.$description: Corner radius for cards and panels.

font-size-sm.$description: Small text, e.g. helper text and metadata.

font-size-lg.$description: Section headings and emphasized amounts, e.g. room rates.

font-family-base.$description: Default typeface across the guest site and back office.

border-width-default.$description: Default border width for cards, inputs, and chips.

button-primary-background.$description: Background of the primary button, e.g. Book now, Save.

button-primary-background-hover.$description: Background of the primary button on hover/active.

button-primary-foreground.$description: Text/icon color on the primary button.

card-default-background.$description: Background of a card, e.g. a room type or reservation card.
